qualification.details: Laboratory Assistant (Biology): Intermediate Science or equivalent in the Subject (Biology). PE/MATH cum Matron (Female only): Four year integrated course/ Bachelor's Degree in Physical Education/ Bachelor of Physical Education and Sports offered by NCTE recognized Institution/ University with at least 50% marks (OR) Graduation from a recognized university and B.P.Ed offered by NCTE recognized Institution/University with at least 50% marks in Graduation and B.P.Ed separately. Band Master/Music Teacher: For Band Master: Pattern of Band Master/ Band Major/Drum Major Course at the AEC Training College and Centre, Pachmarhi or equivalent Naval/ Air Force courses of equivalent course. For Music Teacher: Higher Secondary with a degree or diploma in music from any of the recognised institutions. Ward Boy (General service): Intermediate or equivalent and should be able to converse in English.

Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 11-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Sainik School Ambikapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for Sainik School Ambikapur Recruitment 2026 is 11th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Sainik School Ambikapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies announced for various posts in Sainik School Ambikapur Recruitment 2026. These include Laboratory Assistant, PE/MATH cum Matron, Band Master/Music Teacher, and Ward Boy positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for Sainik School Ambikapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for Sainik School Ambikapur Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the Laboratory Assistant (Biology) post?
faq.answer: For the Laboratory Assistant (Biology) post, candidates must have completed Intermediate Science or an equivalent qualification with Biology as a subject.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the PE/MATH cum Matron (Female only) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the PE/MATH cum Matron (Female only) post in Sainik School Ambikapur Recruitment 2026 is Rs. 71,400/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification should be referred to for details regarding age relaxation for reserved categories. Specific details are not provided in the summary.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC candidates is Rs. 500/- for regular posts and Rs. 200/- for contractual posts.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Sainik School Ambikapur, which is www.sainikschoolambikapur.org.in.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates with the application form.

faq.question: Q10. What is the age criteria for the Ward Boy post?
faq.answer: For the Ward Boy (General service) post, candidates should have completed Intermediate or equivalent and must be able to converse in English. Specific age limits should be checked in the official notification.
